tka.hint.en: Audiences come from Ads Manager → Tools → Audience Manager on this ad account. TikTok needs {min} people in an audience before it delivers; a new one takes up to 48 hours to fill. For retargeting, leave out the buyers.
tka.hint.zh: 受众来自本广告账户的 Ads Manager → 工具 → 受众管理。受众至少要有 {min} 人 TikTok 才会投放；新建的受众最多需要 48 小时填充。做再营销时，请排除已购买的人。

tka.chooseAccount.en: Custom audiences belong to one ad account: choose exactly one in step 2 to pick its audiences.
tka.chooseAccount.zh: 自定义受众属于单个广告账户：请在第 2 步只选择一个广告账户，再选择它的受众。

tka.loading.zh: 正在读取该广告账户的受众…

tka.empty.en: This ad account has no custom audiences yet.
tka.empty.zh: 该广告账户还没有自定义受众。

tka.idHint.en: The number in Audience Manager's ID column.
tka.idHint.zh: 受众管理中 ID 一列的数字。
